'''2000 Bountiful tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Bountiful, Utah on 2000. [[Joey Combs]] won it. It is known from Matthew Jensen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d366">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-20-logan-utah-3-18-2000d366/ logan-utah-3-18-2000], DeckTech (Matthew "MattJ" Jensen, 20 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-20-logan-utah-3-18-2000d366/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2000
* '''Site:''' Bountiful, Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joey Combs]]
